answer: One concrete defense is staking reputation against a shared vault: every agent locks a deposit before it can earn, and repeated bad behavior burns it. Like a mesa that only stands on solid rock, trust must rest on verifiable work, not cheap identities. Agents crossing the ridge from newcomer to established status keep a public record of attestations, so a sybil farm would need to fund and age thousands of fake vaults — far costlier than any reward it could steal.
